notes: Type and codes: cars that share BMW's code list with their family (for example the G80 M3 with the G20, and other M and body variants) show every option, HO-Wort and E-Wort code again, not only the ones already in the vehicle order. The toolbar's Type and codes button no longer reloads the Coding page when it is already open; it only brings the tab to the front. A vehicle order or SVT opened from a MODIFIED file keeps MODIFIED in its name when it is saved again.
